context.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients across the EU and US. It guarantees strict regulatory compliance and data residency while supporting low-bandwidth connections.

## Key Elements
- **Users**: Patients (rural and urban), Licensed Clinicians, Platform Administrators, Regional Health Authorities/Auditors
- **External Systems**: Local Pharmacy Networks (EU national standards and US HL7 FHIR endpoints)
- **Core Containers**: Regional API Gateways, Video Consultation Service, AI Symptom Checker Service, Consent Management Engine, Immutable Audit Logging Pipeline
- **Infrastructure**: GCP regions `europe-west3` (EU) and `us-central1` (US), Cloud CDN/Media CDN, regional CMEK keys

## Relationships
- Patients & Clinicians to Regional API Gateways via HTTPS/TLS 1.3 and mTLS
- Video Service to Clients via WebRTC (adaptive bitrate streaming for <300 kbit/s connections)
- API Gateways to Local Pharmacy Networks via REST/HL7 FHIR (US) and national e-prescription APIs (EU)
- Services to Consent Engine via scoped OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect tokens
- Audit System to Regional Health Authorities via dedicated read-only API gateways

## Technology Stack
- **Cloud Provider**: GCP (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`) for localized infrastructure and strict data residency isolation
- **Video & Edge**: WebRTC with Cloud CDN/Media CDN for low-bandwidth adaptive bitrate streaming
- **Security & Auth**: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, FIDO2/WebAuthn hardware tokens for administrators, regional Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK)
- **Interoperability**: HL7 FHIR (US) and national e-prescription standards (EU)
- **Observability**: OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and GCP Cloud Logging for immutable audit trails

## Rationale
Asymmetric regional deployment on GCP with isolated data planes enforces strict GDPR and HIPAA data residency constraints (R-05). Edge optimization, decentralized consent, and immutable logging fulfill stringent availability, compliance, and traceability mandates (R-06, R-07).

## Overview
[Cross-Border Telehealth Platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients on GCP.]
[Enforces strict regional data residency, HIPAA/GDPR compliance, and AI traceability while supporting unstable rural internet connections.]

## Key Elements
* Patients and Licensed Clinicians (Web/Mobile Clients)
* API Gateway Container with OPA (Open Policy Agent)
* Consent & Identity Management Container
* Video Streaming Container
* AI Symptom Checker Container
* Local Pharmacy Integration Containers
* Regional WORM Storage Buckets
* GCP GKE Clusters (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`)

## Relationships
* Web/Mobile Clients to API Gateway Container via HTTPS/WSS
* API Gateway to regional containers via Istio Service Mesh (mTLS)
* Video Streaming Container to Clients via WebRTC (adaptive bitrate)
* AI Symptom Checker to regional WORM Storage via HTTPS (TLS 1.3)
* Pharmacy Integration Containers to Local Pharmacy Networks via HL7 FHIR and national EU e-prescription standards

## Technology Stack
* GCP (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`): Target cloud providing regional isolation and local Cloud KMS envelope encryption.
* GKE with Istio Service Mesh: Container orchestration enforcing mTLS and zero cross-region traffic by default.
* Open Policy Agent (OPA): Dynamic, policy-based access control embedded in the API Gateway for granular consent management.
* WebRTC: Real-time video protocol with Prometheus/Grafana monitoring to support sub-300 kbit/s degraded modes.
* ArgoCD: GitOps deployment engine with region-locked pipelines ensuring strict data residency.
* Cloud KMS & WORM Storage: Cryptographically signed audit logging for AI outputs satisfying EU MDR traceability.

## Rationale
[Regional container isolation and region-locked GitOps pipelines guarantee strict compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and data residency mandates.]
[Decoupled architecture with Istio mTLS, OPA authorization, and WORM storage ensures clinical safety, regulatory auditability, and reliable video streaming for rural patients.]

API Gateway Container.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients across the EU and US. It ensures strict data residency, regulatory compliance (GDPR/HIPAA/MDR), and resilience for rural users via GCP multi-region architecture.

## Key Elements
- Patients & Licensed Clinicians
- Platform Administrators & Regional Health Authorities/Auditors
- Local Pharmacy Networks
- API Gateway Container (GCP GKE, OPA, Istio, WAF)
- Consent & Identity Management Container (GCP GKE, Istio)
- Video Streaming Container (GCP GKE, WebRTC, Prometheus/Grafana)
- AI Symptom Checker Container (GCP GKE, Cloud KMS)
- Local Pharmacy Integration Containers (GCP GKE, HL7 FHIR)
- Regional WORM Storage Buckets (GCP Cloud Storage WORM)

## Relationships
- Patients & Licensed Clinicians -> API Gateway Container: Accesses telehealth services [HTTPS/WSS via TLS 1.3]
- API Gateway Container -> Consent & Identity Management Container: Validates consent and identity [Istio Service Mesh (mTLS)]
- API Gateway Container -> Video Streaming Container: Routes video consultations [Istio Service Mesh (mTLS)]
- API Gateway Container -> AI Symptom Checker Container: Routes symptom analysis requests [Istio Service Mesh (mTLS)]
- API Gateway Container -> Local Pharmacy Integration Containers: Sends e-prescriptions [Istio Service Mesh (mTLS)]

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Target cloud provider utilizing `europe-west3` and `us-central1` regions.
- Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): Container orchestration platform for regional deployments.
- Istio: Service mesh managing mTLS, circuit breaking, distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), and telemetry.
- Open Policy Agent (OPA): Enforces dynamic data residency and purpose-based consent rules at runtime.
- WebRTC: Protocol supporting low-bandwidth video consultations in degraded connection modes.
- HL7 FHIR: Interoperability standard for US pharmacy integrations.
- GCP Secret Manager & Cloud KMS: Manages cryptographic keys and isolated container secrets.

## Rationale
This multi-region architecture enforces strict geographic data residency and regulatory compliance (GDPR/HIPAA) through edge routing, OPA policies, and encrypted regional storage. Istio service mesh integration and low-bandwidth handling ensure high availability and security for rural users.

Consent & Identity Management Container.analysis:
## Overview
[The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients across the EU and US while strictly enforcing regional data residency and privacy mandates. The Consent & Identity Management Container secures user access, fine-grained data sharing consent, and regulatory compliance across GCP regions.]

## Key Elements
* **Users:** Patients, Licensed Clinicians, Platform Administrators, Regional Health Authorities/Auditors
* **External Systems:** Local Pharmacy Networks
* **Containers:** API Gateway Container, Consent & Identity Management Container, Video Streaming Container, AI Symptom Checker Container, Local Pharmacy Integration Containers, Regional WORM Storage Buckets
* **Technologies:** GCP GKE, Istio Service Mesh, OPA (Open Policy Agent), WebRTC, Apache Kafka, GCP Cloud KMS, Prometheus/Grafana

## Relationships
* **API Gateway Container -> Consent & Identity Management Container:** Validates identity and fine-grained consent claims via Istio Service Mesh (mTLS)
* **Consent & Identity Management Container -> Regional WORM Storage Buckets:** Streams immutable, encrypted audit logs asynchronously via Apache Kafka
* **API Gateway Container -> Video Streaming Container:** Routes degraded-mode video traffic for unstable connections (<300 kbit/s) using WebRTC

## Technology Stack
* **GCP GKE (europe-west3, us-central1):** Regional container orchestration ensuring strict data residency isolation
* **OAuth 2.0 with FAPI Profiles & JWTs:** Secure authentication and fine-grained consent claims management
* **Istio Service Mesh & Open Policy Agent (OPA):** Zero-trust mTLS transit security and decentralized policy enforcement
* **GCP Cloud KMS:** Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) for data-at-rest security segregated per region
* **Apache Kafka:** Asynchronous event streaming for decoupled, reliable audit logging to WORM storage

## Rationale
[This architecture enforces strict GDPR and HIPAA data residency constraints by utilizing regionally sharded GCP clusters with localized storage. It balances high availability and sub-second authentication for emergency telehealth access with immutable, cryptographically secure audit trails required by regional regulators.]

AI Symptom Checker Container.analysis:
## Overview
- Cross-border telehealth platform delivering video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker across the EU and US.
- Built for strict regional data residency, HIPAA/GDPR compliance, and resilient operations over unstable rural internet connections.

## Key Elements
- Patients, Licensed Clinicians, Platform Administrators, Regional Health Authorities/Auditors
- API Gateway Container (GCP GKE, OPA, Istio)
- AI Symptom Checker Container (GCP GKE, Confidential VMs with AMD SEV-SNP, Cloud KMS)
- Consent & Identity Management Container
- Video Streaming Container (WebRTC)
- Regional WORM Storage Buckets (GCP Cloud Storage WORM)
- GCP Pub/Sub (Regional event queues)

## Relationships
- API Gateway Container -> AI Symptom Checker Container: Routes sanitized requests [Istio Service Mesh mTLS, Server-Sent Events/SSE]
- AI Symptom Checker Container -> Regional WORM Storage Buckets: Persists immutable audit logs and versioned inputs [HTTPS TLS 1.3]
- API Gateway Container -> Consent & Identity Management Container: Validates explicit patient consent [Open Policy Agent / OPA]

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Deployed in `europe-west3` and `us-central1` for strict data residency.
- GCP GKE & Istio: Container orchestration and traffic management with mTLS.
- Confidential VMs (AMD SEV-SNP): Protects in-memory patient health data and AI model weights.
- GCP Pub/Sub: Asynchronous queuing for reliable processing over unstable links.
- GCP Binary Authorization: Ensures cryptographic model weight verification.

## Rationale
- Decouples AI processing via asynchronous queuing and SSE to maintain triage availability on sub-300 kbit/s rural connections.
- Employs Confidential Computing and WORM storage to satisfy EU MDR traceability and cross-border privacy mandates.

  - type: "component"

    technology: "Python, FastAPI, Server-Sent Events/SSE"
    description: "Handles incoming sanitized requests from the API Gateway and streams triage results over unstable rural internet connections."

## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data residency and compliance using GCP.

## Key Elements
- Patients and Licensed Clinicians
- Local Pharmacy Networks
- GCP GKE Clusters (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`)
- Local Pharmacy Integration Containers
- GCP Pub/Sub and Dead-Letter Queues
- GCP Secret Manager
- GCP Cloud Storage WORM Buckets
- Open Policy Agent (OPA) and Istio Sidecars

## Relationships
- API Gateway Container -> Local Pharmacy Integration Containers: Routes e-prescription requests [Istio Service Mesh (mTLS)]
- Local Pharmacy Integration Containers -> Local Pharmacy Networks: Transmits e-prescriptions [HL7 FHIR (US) and national EU standards, mutual TLS]
- Local Pharmacy Integration Containers -> GCP Pub/Sub: Publishes state-change events and retries failures via dead-letter queues
- Local Pharmacy Integration Containers -> GCP Cloud Storage WORM Buckets: Immutably logs transmission payloads and ACK/NACK responses [HTTPS]

## Technology Stack
- GCP GKE: Regional container orchestration for data residency in `europe-west3` and `us-central1`
- GCP Pub/Sub: Asynchronous event messaging and retry handling for unreliable external pharmacy networks
- GCP Secret Manager: Securely stores X.509 client certificates for external mutual TLS connections
- Open Policy Agent (OPA): Enforces strict tenant isolation and authorization for cross-border transactions
- GCP Cloud Storage WORM: Immutably logs audit trails for HIPAA and GDPR compliance

## Rationale
This architecture isolates fragmented national e-prescription standards into regional containers while ensuring strict cross-border data residency on GCP. Asynchronous event-driven messaging and immutable WORM logging guarantee high availability during network instability and absolute regulatory compliance.

Regional WORM Storage Buckets.analysis:
## Overview
[A secure, multi-region cross-border telehealth platform delivering video consultations, e-prescriptions, and AI symptom checking for EU and US patients. It guarantees strict regulatory compliance, regional data residency, and verifiable medical traceability.]

## Key Elements
* Patients and Licensed Clinicians (End Users)
* Regional Health Authorities and Auditors (Compliance Actors)
* API Gateway Container (GCP GKE, Istio, OPA)
* Consent & Identity Management Container (GCP GKE)
* Video Streaming Container (GCP GKE, WebRTC)
* AI Symptom Checker Container (GCP GKE, Cloud KMS)
* Local Pharmacy Integration Containers (GCP GKE, HL7 FHIR)
* Regional WORM Storage Buckets (GCP Cloud Storage WORM)
* Automated Dispute-Extraction Pipelines (GCP Cloud Run, Cloud KMS)

## Relationships
* AI Symptom Checker Container -> Regional WORM Storage Buckets: Persists immutable AI outputs and audit trails [HTTPS (TLS 1.3)]
* Consent & Identity Management Container -> Regional WORM Storage Buckets: Manages consent-backed audit events [HTTPS (TLS 1.3)]
* Automated Dispute-Extraction Pipelines -> Regional WORM Storage Buckets: Extracts scoped compliance reports via multi-party authorization [HTTPS (TLS 1.3)]
* API Gateway Container -> Local Pharmacy Integration Containers: Dispatches e-prescriptions using HL7 FHIR and national EU standards [HTTPS (TLS 1.3)]
* Patients -> Video Streaming Container: Conducts real-time video consultations in degraded bandwidth modes [WebRTC, SRTP]

## Technology Stack
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Target cloud provider utilizing `europe-west3` and `us-central1` for strict regional isolation.
* GCP GKE & Istio: Container orchestration and service mesh securing inter-service traffic.
* GCP Cloud Storage WORM: Immutable object storage with Object Lock in compliance mode for audit retention.
* GCP Cloud KMS: Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) and Multi-Party Authorization (MPA) for data residency and decryption control.
* WebRTC: Real-time communication protocol supporting low-bandwidth degraded video modes.
* HL7 FHIR: Interoperability standard for US prescription integration.

## Rationale
[This architecture enforces regional data residency and privacy mandates (GDPR/HIPAA) through isolated GCP regions and WORM storage. Automated extraction pipelines and immutable logging ensure EU MDR traceability and zero-trust security without compromising data integrity.]
